name: Data motion
summary: Animate bar, line and donut charts, sparklines, counters, delta badges and a before/after comparison so numbers read at phone size.
qualityBar: fmt never adds a currency sign; easeNumber lands exactly, is monotonic and never overshoots
Bar lengths are exactly proportional to values; outBack tip overshoot stays between 2 and 15 percent; growth lands at exactly 1
Line chart head lands on the last value and stays inside the plot; monotone curve passes through every point and never leaves the data range
Donut slices plus gaps close the circle, fill in order, shares sum to 1, colours land at their angles
readability() flags too many items, labels wider than 40 percent, text under 42 px and more than 3 series
Demo: engine QC passes on the card and on the mp4 (safe zones, 42 px floor, no frozen frames, closer present)
verifiedBy: 2026-11-19: node test.mjs exit 0 at full size 1080x1920 (57 checks passed, 0 failed; demo 8 s, silent; engine QC on the card and on the mp4 passed). I viewed out/contact.png and, separately, a still of vertical bars + scan bars + a down badge, and judged them good. Fixed during the run: the '0%' centre number showed over the previous page before the donut started (now hidden until the sweep begins). NOT checked: motion judged from stills and motion-energy numbers, never played back by a person; vertical bars, the scan highlight and the down badge are covered by unit checks and one still but are not in the demo video; charts with negative values (the baseline is fixed at 0 for bars; line charts accept min); more than 3 series; very long label strings beyond what readability() measures.
